subject.title: [Feature]: Feishu Group Chat SubAgents for User-Specific Skills and Memory

question: Should Feishu group chats get an opt-in dynamic per-sender agent mode, or should OpenClaw limit supported group isolation to groupSessionScope/session binding for now?
rationale: The remaining work is not a narrow bug fix; it changes Feishu group routing, dynamic config writes, per-user skill/memory boundaries, cleanup quotas, and security expectations.

options.title: Design opt-in group dynamic agents
options.body: Approve a Feishu plugin design that extends dynamicAgentCreation to authorized group senders with explicit limits, cleanup, and security documentation before implementation.

options.title: Keep session-only group isolation
options.body: Treat groupSessionScope/group_topic_sender as the supported group-chat isolation path and update docs to avoid implying group dynamic agents exist.

options.title: Externalize advanced orchestration
options.body: Keep OpenClaw core/official Feishu lean and let advanced per-user skills/admin orchestration live in a separate ClawHub/plugin package unless a missing API is proven.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in group dynamic agents
recommendation.body: Approve a Feishu plugin design that extends dynamicAgentCreation to authorized group senders with explicit limits, cleanup, and security documentation before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu package metadata identifies @m1heng as the community maintainer signal for this plugin, making them the best first routing candidate for product direction.
